summary: News Corp filed an 8-K to disclose daily repurchase information provided to the Australian Securities Exchange under its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program for Class A and Class B common stock. The program authorizes acquisitions from time to time; specific daily terms (price, number of shares) are in the attached exhibits. The filing does not name a board recommendation or advisor. Although an ASX daily disclosure, the US 8-K serves as a current report of a capital-return activity. The repurchase is ongoing with no set expiration; what to watch is the pace and volume of buybacks versus the $1 billion authorization.
